name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-02-15.153.1) introduced by Melbourne MP [Adam Bandt](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/melbourne/adam_bandt) (Greens), which means it failed. Mr Bandt [explained the reason](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-02-15.153.1) behind his motion: > *There is a loophole that has been open since November 2019 that is hampering the work of the disability royal commission and that is stopping people having the confidence to come and tell their stories.* ### Motion text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words—* > > *"the Bill be considered immediately".*
